core: Removing worked examples/demonstrations from a prompt while keeping instructions or formatting cues intact causes a larger performance drop than removing the instructions/formatting cues alone
quote_1: Been doing ⟧T1⟧ runs on our support-ticket agent all week — pulled every worked example out of the prompt but left the step outline and formatting hints exactly where they were. Success rate went from 74% to 39%.
quote_2: ⟧T2⟧ increased sharply when the solved demonstration was withheld from the smaller systems. ⟧T2⟧ changed little when only output-format reminders were removed, suggesting that the effect was not driven solely by answer serialization.
